title: Accounting Agents research corpus
mission: A public, read-only research corpus that helps people and agents find, understand, and reuse the information needed to build accounting agents.
coverage_note: Local AA-INT126 integration 2026-09-18.1: the verified 2026-09-17.5 corpus is extended with four bounded assurance and controls families, eight added named questions, a synthetic evidence packet, and four partial shared-context assessments. The integration preserves the qualified nongovernmental US nonprofit contribution and restriction package, bounded US operating-transaction foundations, the bounded US management-accounting package, the AA-I127 ERP evidence-boundaries package, and the AA-R118 reporting-foundations package. The four assurance families keep PCAOB, AICPA AU-C, federal-award, SOC, Nacha, and government contexts separate. Inherited undated source checks, unknown effective periods and rights, and partial criteria remain explicit. The corpus retains the existing 96 subsector profiles, 5,952 applicability screenings and 1,012 individual industry exception reviews. Named answers remain partial or evidence gaps; no whole question family, subsector or detailed industry is assessed sufficient. Existing international material is retained without substituting it for US authority.
review_note: The 2026-09-18.1 edition is a local AA-INT126 integration from verified main 92bfc034183adf7857ed291158a7ba64f50fb8a1. It ports the accepted AA-R126 assurance and controls content through the current conflict-aware importer, preserving current metadata, rights, source checks and accepted packages. The four new assessments are partial routing anchors only. The accepted local 2026-09-17.126 snapshot remains provenance for the source review and is not treated as a release snapshot. The mainline 2026-09-17.2 history and the alternate AA-R126 historical lineage remain immutable; this edition uses a distinct 2026-09-18.1 release and snapshot. No current consolidated Codification review, professional sign-off, operating effectiveness, empirical agent performance or rights clearance is established. Applicability, accounting adequacy, source currency, professional review, empirical support and reuse rights remain independent. This local preparation does not publish or close AA-R126.
rights_note: Project-created factual metadata is CC0 1.0. Original editorial content is CC BY 4.0. Software is MIT. External source content is not redistributed or licensed by this project; access is not permission for training or reuse.
coverage_priorities: Reverify inherited source URLs, editions, effective dates, supersession, and evidence classifications; keep release-specific checks current.
Add jurisdiction-specific accounting, audit, tax, payroll, and public-sector authorities beyond the present US, European and selected other coverage.
Deepen real transaction-level and ledger evidence, finance-specific CDC/deletion behavior, ERP completeness and reconciliation examples; documented contracts remain untested here.
Add independent empirical deployment studies, incident and failure reports, and reproducible accounting workflow evidence beyond controlled questions and synthetic datasets.
Resolve dataset-specific and upstream permissions, including TabFormer and the FiFAR/BAF interaction; keep unknown rights unknown.

Deepen construction coverage with current consolidated GAAP review, state-specific tax and public-works rules, contract and job-cost datasets, ERP lineage and professional validation; continue other industry guidance including nonprofit and government implementation.
